description: This is a C source file configuring hardware and GPIO settings for the nRF9160DK board in Zephyr RTOS, including GPIO initialization, reset handling, and device routing.

methods.name: chip_reset
methods.description: Handles GPIO reset line assertion and triggers system reset.

methods.name: reset_pin_wait_inactive
methods.description: Waits until the reset GPIO pin becomes inactive.

methods.name: reset_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures the GPIO reset pin and sets up interrupt handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes routing switches and optionally configures reset GPIO.

methods.name: early_init
methods.description: Enables external flash signals early during system startup.
